n: New stages - 'Kernel Breakthrough' and 'Special Front' are now open

list: During the Vector Breakthrough event, clear Level 8 in Kernel Breakthrough.

Under your leadership, the team successfully completed all Kernel Breakthroughs in Vector Breakthrough.
The operators held a party to celebrate the victory. Even Rosmontis was happy to join. She will remember these moments of growing together with everyone.
During the Vector Breakthrough event, clear Level 5 in Kernel Breakthrough.

Your team excelled on the Kernel Breakthrough training ground.
The operators eagerly anticipate each future test, hoping you'll lead them in battle.
During the Vector Breakthrough event, defeat V. T. E. 5 times.

You led the operators in defeating a sufficient quantity of Vector Tactical Equipment.
You withstood the pressure of manifested thoughts. In fact, that very resistance has brought strength to your team.
During the Vector Breakthrough event, obtain The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca outfit.

A video game achievement medal sent from Vanilla as a thank you for guiding the team through the training assessment.
'These Originium slugs, they all listen to you now. Of course, I knew that would be easy for you, Doctor.'
During the Vector Breakthrough event, defeat 4 different Garrisons in Special Front.

Your team cut through all the challenges on the Special Front training ground.
Thanks to your knowledge of the battlefield and the enemy, the operators have achieved success in small-scale combat trainings.
